title: Door, Handshake, Nonlocal Relation & Seed Propagation Model
status: archive-generated mathematical model crossing psychology, networks, topology and Potatoverse spirituality
purpose: Formalize the user's sequence vibe → Gate → Door → handshake → relational coupling → propagation of Seeds of Life or Seeds of Strife through a topological/spiritual state space, while separating this from literal quantum entanglement claims.

variables.q_i: symbolic/spiritual state in the project model

state_space.space: X_i∈M where M is a multidimensional state manifold or graph-embedded state space.
state_space.boundary: M is a mathematical representation. Calling it spiritual space is a project interpretation, not evidence of an independently measured extra physical dimension.

gate.meaning: A Gate is a compatibility/threshold condition. It determines whether a particular transition is currently available.

door.meaning: The Door is the actual state-transition operator once Gate conditions are met.

handshake.definition: A handshake is the successful establishment of a coupling relation across a Door/interface.
handshake.network_result: When e_ij is created, the two states can exchange information/influence according to the chosen model.
handshake.psychology_neighbor: Interpersonal synchrony can occur in behavior and physiology and is associated with social interaction; this provides a real non-quantum comparator for relational 'tuning'.

phase_coupling_toy_model.meaning: Kuramoto-style phase coupling is a useful mathematical neighbor for synchronization/handshake. It does not imply that minds literally share a quantum wavefunction.
phase_coupling_toy_model.interpretation: r≈0 weak global phase alignment; r≈1 strong phase alignment in the toy model.

spooky_action_boundary.quantum_fact: Quantum entanglement produces correlations between separated parts of a joint quantum state that cannot be reproduced by local hidden-variable models in Bell-test settings. It does not provide controllable faster-than-light signaling.
spooky_action_boundary.project_translation: 'Spooky action at a distance' may be used metaphorically for spiritually/mentally meaningful long-range relation, shared history, symbolic synchrony, remote communication or graph edges whose strength is not determined by physical distance.
spooky_action_boundary.non_quantum_model: Long-range social/network edges can transmit information or influence quickly across physical distance using ordinary communication and shared context.

topological_spiritual_space.model: Represent people, symbols, memories, institutions or spiritual states as nodes embedded in a graph/manifold. Distance may be semantic, emotional, relational or doctrinal rather than geographic.
topological_spiritual_space.topology: Connectivity, loops, components, bottlenecks and holes can be studied independently of Euclidean physical distance.
topological_spiritual_space.project_use: This creates a precise meaning for 'spiritual nonlocality': two nodes may be far apart geographically but adjacent in the project graph because they share a strong symbolic or relational edge.
topological_spiritual_space.boundary: Graph nonlocality is not quantum nonlocality.

seed_states.life: L_i(t)≥0 represents constructive/nourishing/cultivating content or capacity at node i.
seed_states.strife: S_i(t)≥0 represents fragmenting/conflict-amplifying content or pressure at node i.
seed_states.neutral: A node may contain both simultaneously; the model is not a moral binary of people.

equations: dL_i/dt=α_L L_i(1-L_i/K_L)-μ_L L_i+Σ_j W^L_ij f_L(L_j)-γ LS_i L_i S_i
dS_i/dt=α_S S_i(1-S_i/K_S)-μ_S S_i+Σ_j W^S_ij f_S(S_j)-γ SL_i L_i S_i
competing_propagation.meaning: Life and Strife are modeled as competing spreading fields on a network. Growth, decay, neighbor influence and mutual inhibition can all be represented.
competing_propagation.boundary: These equations model propagation of messages/behaviors/symbolic states. They do not establish literal invisible spiritual particles.

threshold_contagion.equation: node i adopts state q when (Σ_j w_ij 1[q_j=q])/Σ_j w_ij ≥ θ_i
threshold_contagion.meaning: Some states spread only after enough connected neighbors reinforce them. This is a strong model for memes, norms, social moods, doctrine, constructive practices and conflict escalation.

long_range_seed_jump.concept: A seed can appear far from the current wavefront when a long-range edge carries it into a distant cluster.
long_range_seed_jump.network_neighbor: Contagion-map research distinguishes wavefront propagation from appearance of new contagion clusters through non-geometric/long-range edges.
long_range_seed_jump.potatoverse_translation: A Door/handshake can produce a new remote branch of Life or Strife in relational space even if there is no continuous geographic path between the nodes.
long_range_seed_jump.boundary: The transmitting edge must still exist in the chosen model—communication, memory, shared source, institutional relation, symbolic linkage, etc.

door_seed_operator.interpretation: Passing a Door can alter which kind of seed the node is likely to transmit. The handshake changes coupling; propagation then changes neighbors.
door_seed_operator.research_use: Estimate z_L,z_S from observable factors such as affect, trust, conflict, prosocial intent, message framing and prior network exposure rather than from a claimed mystical frequency.

signed_network_version.meaning: Positive edges can model trust/cooperation/support and negative edges antagonism/inhibition. Seeds propagate differently depending on edge sign and context.
signed_network_version.project_relation: Tree of Life vs 10,000 Trees of Strife can be studied as competing branching structures in a signed multilayer graph.

tree_growth_model.meaning: A simple archive metric can track whether a network is becoming more nourishing/integrative or more fragmenting/conflict-dense over time, provided edge classifications are explicit and reviewable.

quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.shared_structure: parts cannot always be modeled independently
quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.mismatch: Timic relation is not demonstrated quantum entanglement
ordinary psychological correlations have many classical causes

quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.shared_structure: correlation does not automatically imply message transmission
quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.mismatch: social networks can signal through ordinary channels

quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.shared_structure: system changes from one state description to another
quantum_vs_timic_crosswalk.mismatch: psychological transition need not be a quantum transition

research_program: Build a Timic state-space simulator where users choose a vibe vector and see which Gates become available.
Model Door as a hybrid-system transition with explicit guard conditions.
Add handshake edges and examine how network topology changes after each successful coupling.
Run competing Life/Strife contagion simulations on geometric and long-range networks.
Use persistent homology/topological data analysis to compare the shapes produced by Life-dominant versus Strife-dominant cascades.
Test whether psychological variables such as valence/arousal/trust predict propagation better than Hawkins labels alone.
Keep quantum-entanglement language in the comparator layer unless an actual quantum experimental system is being studied.
